purpose: Turn bounded cross-platform observations into an evidence-linked audience change proposal without publishing, spending, contacting people, or mutating an account.

objective_signals: The objective requires deeper audience evidence across one or more supported public platform surfaces before changing audience, content, positioning, or channel strategy.
prerequisites: The decision question, requested platforms, lawful read-only access method, sampling frame, data-retention boundary, and no-contact authority are explicit.

nodes.objective: Bind one audience decision question, requested platforms, evidence threshold, access and privacy boundary, sampling limits, non-goals, resource cap, and stop rule.
Produce a cross-platform audience research package with pinned observations, source tiers, coverage, sampling limits, insights, counterevidence, unknowns, confidence, and bounded recommendations.
Translate the exact research package into an audience-change proposal that separates observation, interpretation, and hypothesis while preserving exclusions, biases, counterevidence, and uncertainty.

Review the exact audience-change proposal and supporting research package for access authority, traceability, sampling claims, privacy, bias, counterevidence, revision binding, and no-contact compliance.
